adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null`. Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the diff adds `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Since `destinationCalendar` can be `null` in the just-constructed `evt`, the optional-chained `push` will be skipped, and any `teamDestinationCalendars` accumulated from other team members will not be appended. This is directly verifiable from the diff and results in silently missing destination calendars for COLLECTIVE events when the organizer/eventType has no destination calendar but other hosts do.
